summary: Frontend E2E testing of LIVO camera modal, upload pipeline (Bill Checker / Cash Assistant / Change Checker), and Voice hands-free toggle. Used mobile viewport (390x844) on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Generated realistic feature-rich JPEGs via /app/backend/tests/image_factory.py (correct receipt, wrong-math receipt, INR notes 500+500+100+50+20, and change notes 50+20+10=80) and drove the hidden camera-upload-input to exercise the 'Upload Instead' path (same processImage pipeline). 8/8 checks passed with 0 console errors/warnings and 0 page errors. Backend vision endpoints (~5-15s) returned end-to-end results as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: CameraCapture: doCapture calls stop()+onClose() BEFORE onCapture. If getUserMedia never becomes ready (or in automation), doCapture returns null silently — the modal closes with no user feedback. Consider showing a toast/setError when grabFrame returns null.

CameraCapture cleanup effect returns stop from a useEffect whose deps include stop; the initial (async) start path won't call cancelled correctly if getUserMedia resolves after the effect cleanup (stream tracks stopped, then a new stream may be assigned). The cancelled check guards this — OK, minor.

VoiceContext runLoop retries 'I did not hear you' every ~250ms when the browser has no SpeechRecognition support but startHandsFree still gates on isSpeechRecognitionSupported — good. On automated headless Chromium isSpeechRecognitionSupported returned true (aria-pressed flipped and the loop starts). Verify that clicking off cleanly cancels; here the second click reset aria-pressed=false as expected.

BillChecker: after receiving an error message from analyzeBill, the previous result stays cleared (setResult(null)) but the preview is retained — acceptable. Ensure the bill-issues list is only rendered when !verified (currently correct).
Change Checker: verdict tolerance is |diff|<0.5, which correctly classified 80 vs 80 as 'Change is correct'. Consider making the threshold configurable for rupees-only workflows.

processImage in ChangeChecker validates tenderedNum>0 && billNum>0 but the CameraCapture is opened before validation; user can open camera, capture, then get an error toast. Consider disabling change-scan-btn until both inputs are populated.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral JPEGs written to /tmp during test run (correct_receipt.jpg, wrong_receipt.jpg, cash_notes.jpg, change_notes.jpg). No DB seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/image_factory.py to generate valid receipts and INR-note images at runtime. The 'Upload Instead' fallback inside camera-modal drives the same processImage pipeline as Capture — use data-testid='camera-upload-input' with set_input_files. Vision endpoints take 5-15s; use 45s timeouts on result selectors. Voice hands-free toggle relies on browser SpeechRecognition — Chromium reports it as supported and the aria-pressed toggles cleanly; TTS may auto-play a greeting but does not crash. Console errors were zero across all screens.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested flows work: Bill Checker (verified + issues), Cash Assistant (notes + total ₹1170), Change Checker (expected ₹80 & verdict 'Change is correct'), and the Voice header toggle. No console errors or runtime exceptions observed.
